chars.BROTHER: BROTHER: a Moroccan man about 36 with a short trimmed black beard and slicked-back hair, wearing a camel wool overcoat over a black turtleneck, a silver wristwatch
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a Moroccan man about 32, clean-shaven, thin black rectangular glasses, short curly hair, wearing a navy quarter-zip sweater over a white collared shirt
chars.WOMAN: WOMAN: a Moroccan woman about 28 with long dark wavy hair, wearing a dusty-pink knit cardigan over a cream top, small gold hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. BROTHER pacing in a dim modern apartment at night, holding his phone to his ear, leaning forward with a sly, insistent smile, like he is about to ask a big favour; head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, seen from a doorway. Calm plain background edges, subject centred. No text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. NARRATOR sitting on a sofa in a modest Casablanca living room, phone at his ear, one eyebrow raised, suspicious and puzzled expression, a cup of tea on a low table; head-to-waist framing, face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. Close-up of BROTHER on the phone grinning widely, raising his free hand as if teasing, playful mischievous eyes, warm lamp light behind him; face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. NARRATOR standing up from the sofa with the phone at his ear, frozen with wide eyes and open mouth, shocked, his other hand on his head; head-to-waist framing, face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. WOMAN sitting alone by a window in a Moroccan bedroom, pale and tired, wrapped in a blanket, looking at an old photo on her phone with a thoughtful, longing face; head-to-waist framing, face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. BROTHER on the phone, pointing his finger forward with a big knowing smile, as if saying 'she wants you', confident, standing in his apartment; head-to-waist framing, face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. NARRATOR on the phone, shaking his head and waving his free hand as if refusing, but a hidden small smile on his lips, sitting at a desk with a laptop in his Casablanca flat; head-to-waist framing, face visible, centred. No text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, vertical. Night, dark bedroom lit only by the phone screen: NARRATOR lying in bed wide awake, holding his phone above his face, staring at it nervously, waiting for a message; face visible and lit blue, centred. No text.
